title: Login profiles for NoAuth
description: This defines the format for the Oidc profiles to use as templates

clients.description: The list of extra claims granted to specific client_id

..description: A claim to grant to the client. Use 'scope' to add scope.

items.description: A template for user profiles to login with. Properties that are not defined, are generated.

profileName.description: The display name of the profile. This should be unique, to be used as an identifier.

given_name.description: The given name of the user profile generated.

family_name.description: The family name of the user profile generated.

uid.description: The user id of the user profile generated.

..description: A claim to add to the user profile generated.

patternProperties.description: A required list of claims to add to the user profile generated.
